newsitem.title: USA: Southern Pacific acquires National Capital.
newsitem.headline: Southern Pacific acquires National Capital.

text.p: Southern Pacific Funding Corp on Tuesday said it has agreed to acquire 95 percent of the equity in National Capital Funding Inc, a mortgage lending service company, for $5.0 million in cash.

The other 5 percent equity will be acquired by National Capital Funding management. The deal allows management to repurchase a controlling interest based on future production and profit goals and upon future cash consideration.

National Capital Funding Inc is a newly created holding company with headquarters in Atlanta. It operates mortgage lending services through three units, MorCap Inc, National Capital Funding Corp and Catalyst Funding.
MorCap is a non-conforming residential real estate lender, National Capital Funding Corp. is a commercial real estate lender and Catalyst Funding operates credit leaseback lending services.
